name: saved-replies-create-permission
description: Saved Replies split into access and create: the admin restricts one member, the member can use replies but not add them

parts.name: admin
parts.before: profile/ signed in as the admin; the demo member's 'Can create Saved Replies' ON (this take turns it off and fails fast if it already is)

parts.name: member
